title: UPSC Combined Medical Services CMS Admit Card 2026
vacancyDetails: About 1,358 Medical Officer posts (Category I & II) under Combined Medical Services
qualification: MBBS degree as per UPSC CMS rules
ageLimit: Below 32 years (as on crucial date; relaxations as per UPSC rules)
selectionProcess: Computer Based Examination → Personality Test / Interview
documentsRequired: Registration ID & DOB/password for e-Admit Card; photo ID on exam day
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsconline.nic.in or upsc.gov.in e-Admit Card portal
2. Select Combined Medical Services Examination 2026
3. Enter Registration ID and Date of Birth
4. Download and print e-Admit Card
5. Read instructions carefully before exam day
shortDescription: UPSC CMS Admit Card 2026 released around 24 July 2026 for CBT on 2 August 2026. Download from upsconline.nic.in / UPSC e-Admit Card portal.
content:
The Union Public Service Commission has released the e-Admit Card for the Combined Medical Services Examination, 2026.

The Computer-Based Test is scheduled on 02 August 2026. Admit cards were made available around 24 July 2026.

  • Approximate vacancies: 1,358
  • Download only from official UPSC portals
  • No hard copy is sent by post
